steps.title: Clean holder and distribute powder
steps.instruction: Remove all dust and debris from the 54° pre‑tilted holder, then loosely spread the metallic powder on the 54° side near the top edge; static forces will hold particles temporarily.

steps.title: Load holder and set eucentric height
steps.instruction: Insert the holder into the FEI Helios P‑FIB (or compatible instrument), locate a particle of the desired shape and size, and bring it to eucentric height using the standard procedure described in the referenced methods.

steps.title: Pt coat particle for fixation
steps.instruction: Using FIB Pt deposition, draw a circular pattern whose diameter is 5 µm larger than the selected particle and a z‑depth of 1 µm; repeat this deposition two additional times after rotating the sample +45° and –45° to coat the sides, thereby securing the particle and providing a protective layer.

substeps.instruction: Deposit first Pt circle (diameter = particle diameter + 5 µm, depth = 1 µm).
Rotate sample +45° and deposit second Pt circle with same dimensions.
Rotate sample –45° and deposit third Pt circle with same dimensions.

steps.title: Create Pt fiducial column
steps.instruction: Deposit a Pt column of 10 × 10 × 5 µm near the particle (approximately 10 µm diagonal away), then mill fiducial markers into the side and top of the column—one marker for milling/EBSD and a second for imaging/EBSD.

steps.title: Expose polished particle surface
steps.instruction: Mill away 1–2 µm of the particle with the ion beam, then perform a low‑current polishing pass to obtain a smooth surface suitable for EBSD.

steps.title: Run automated imaging sequence
steps.instruction: Configure imaging parameters as required, then start the automated routine that alternates ion‑beam milling with electron‑beam EBSD imaging to acquire the 3‑D dataset of the particle.

substeps.instruction: Set imaging parameters for the automated sectioning process.
Execute the automated sequence that alternates ion‑beam milling and electron‑beam EBSD imaging.
